notes: Seed http://www.co.dewitt.tx.us/ works over https (first attempts were refused after a robots.txt connection reset during proxy relay failures; it loaded after the retry window). No Clarity or vendor link; page links the SOS 'Texas Election Results'. Hart reports; file names carry the tabulator export time. Last-Modified values differ per file and look like real upload times. The May 2, 2026 school election shows the same pattern (unofficial precinct report printed 8:06 PM on election night). 2024 general and 2026 primary undetermined (check 3 pending; wayback-data branch not on origin).
tag_rationale: Only the 2026 runoff is determined (END, check 2: one election-night precinct report printed 8:33 PM and uploaded 8:42 PM). With exactly one election determined the tag is PRECINCT_END_OF_NIGHT with low confidence.

2024_general.fact: The page lists 'Cumulative' and 'Precinct' reports for Nov 5, 2024; the Precinct report (88 pages, scanned) has PDF CreationDate 2025-01-06 and Last-Modified Mon, 06 Jan 2025 15:43:27 GMT, so it is a later posting and does not show what was available on election night. Check 3 pending.

2026_primary.fact: Only official files remain for the March 3, 2026 primary ('DEMOCRAT CUMULATIVE OFFICIAL RESULTS-3-18-2026 11-34-36 AM.pdf', 'REPUBLICAN CUMULATIVE OFFICIAL RESULTS-3-18-2026 ...', reconciliation forms); nothing shows what was posted on election night. Check 3 pending.

2026_runoff.fact: 'Unofficial Precinct Results' (Precinct Results-5-26-2026 08-33-22 PM ED PRCT REPORT.pdf) is a 23-page Hart 'Precinct Results Report Unofficial Results DE WITT COUNTY, TEXAS ... PRIMARY RUNOFF ELECTION ... Run Time 8:33 PM Run Date 05/26/2026' with per-precinct votes including Election Day Voting (precinct 101: Vikki Goodwin 18 = 5 absentee, 11 early, 2 election day). PDF CreationDate 2026-05-27 01:33:32 UTC; Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 01:42:23 GMT (8:42 PM CDT). It is the only unofficial precinct file for the runoff; the matching 'Unofficial Cumulative Results' is named '... 08-32-49 PM ED REPORT'. Official precinct results followed.
